JetBrains

Style guide

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property from tokens.json, read from jetbrains.com on 2026-11-18. Light is the store, help and login card. Dark is the home campaign. JetBrains paints both with no visitor toggle. The header button sets data-mode so the two schemes can be compared. JetBrains Sans is not loaded here.

Checkout, downloads and the IDE sit behind sign-in. The login wall was photographed empty. Continue with email was not clicked, so profile and licenses are not drawn.

Colour

Roles are page, surface, text, muted, accent and border. The grey ramp and the purple brand live in core and stay put when the scheme changes.
